description: This file defines the PageDisplayVariantSelectionEvent class, which is an event class used during rendering in Drupal to select and configure a page display variant based on the current route and context.

classes.name: PageDisplayVariantSelectionEvent
classes.description: An event class fired during rendering to select and configure a page display variant, providing methods to set plugin ID, configuration, contexts, and access route match.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a plugin ID and current route match.

methods.name: setPluginId
methods.description: Sets the plugin ID for the page display variant.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin ID for the page display variant.

methods.name: setPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration array for the selected page display variant.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the configuration array for the selected page display variant.

methods.name: getRouteMatch
methods.description: Returns the current route match object.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns the array of contexts set during event dispatch.

methods.name: setContexts
methods.description: Sets the contexts to be passed to the page display variant.
